I pulled these from USPS's own Retail Postage Price Calculator (postcalc.usps.com). The zones come from USPS's Zone Chart tool on the same site, using the "ZIP code pair" lookup. Everything was run on 2026-10-17 from 94107 with a 12×9×4 in box, and I used the "Retail" price column, not Click-N-Ship.

| Destination | Zone | Priority Mail 2 lb | Priority Mail 6 lb | Ground Advantage 2 lb | Ground Advantage 6 lb |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 10001 (New York, NY) | 8 | $22.55 | $43.95 | $19.80 | $29.75 |
| 60601 (Chicago, IL) | 8 | $22.55 | $43.95 | $19.80 | $29.75 |
| 33101 (Miami, FL) | 8 | $22.55 | $43.95 | $19.80 | $29.75 |
| 98101 (Seattle, WA) | 5 | $17.85 | $25.35 | $14.85 | $19.80 |
| 96813 (Honolulu, HI) | 8 | $22.55 | $43.95 | $19.80 | $29.75 |

- **Same price for all zone 8 destinations:** USPS prices by zone, so four different cities coming back identical is expected.
- **Priority Mail rate:** I used the standard Priority Mail rate, not the Flat Rate Box. USPS also offered a Large Flat Rate Box at $36.10, which is cheaper than the 6 lb zone 8 price of $43.95. That box is 12¼ × 12 × 6 in, so your box won't fit in it.
- **Calculator label:** The calculator labels the shipment "Large Package". I entered the dimensions as 12 L × 9 W × 4 H.
- **Estimated delivery:** Ground Advantage to Honolulu shows Oct 31, versus Oct 22–24 for the others.
- **Zones are origin-specific:** These zones only apply to shipments from 94107.
- **No re-check of the 5-zone prices:** I read each result straight off the page and didn't run a second pass to confirm the Seattle prices.

I also opened a browser session at the start whose "last scrape" later pointed at an unrelated Chrome Web Store page. I only read that page and changed nothing. I stopped the USPS session when I finished.
